<?php
function &values95() { global $v; echo "Y;"; yield 0 => $v; echo "N:",$v,";"; }
function sink95(&$x) { echo "S:",$x,";"; $x=33; echo "R:",$x,";"; }
function warning95($level,$message) { global $old; unset($GLOBALS['v']); $GLOBALS['v'] =& $GLOBALS['other']; $old=22; echo "H:",$GLOBALS['v'],":",$old,";"; return true; }
$v=11; $old=&$v; $other=44; set_error_handler('warning95'); echo "B;"; $g=values95(); sink95(...$g); echo "V:",$v,":",$old,":",$other,";"; unset($g);
purpose: Rebinding the actual GLOBALS name must not redirect the saved dereferenced CELL designation

<?php
function &values95() { global $v; echo "Y0;"; yield 0 => $v; echo "Y1;"; $v=30; yield 1 => $v; echo "N:",$v,";"; }
function sink95(&$first,&$second) { echo "S:",$first,":",$second,";"; $first=91; $second=92; echo "R:",$first,":",$second,";"; }
function warning95($level,$message) { global $alias; $alias=$alias+1; echo "H:",$alias,";"; return true; }
$v=10; $alias=&$v; set_error_handler('warning95'); echo "B;"; $g=values95(); sink95(...$g); echo "V:",$v,":",$alias,";"; unset($g);
purpose: Two warnings reread one live source cell independently while earlier SENT snapshots remain in distinct private cells
